prompt: Create ONE new 3:2 landscape illustration for a Catalan school listening worksheet. Inputs are character identity and style REFERENCES only, not edit targets. Soft watercolor and colored-pencil storybook drawing on warm ivory paper, muted sage and earth tones, natural relaxed expressions, one single coherent scene. Match the reference characters precisely. Not a character sheet. No readable text, labels, numbers, logos, border, or watermark. Do not visually reveal answers to comprehension questions. Mar, adult woman with dark brown low ponytail, olive blazer and cream shirt, is making a radio report with a handheld microphone in an ordinary school courtyard. Beside her is a young leafy tree still in a plain large nursery pot, with closed gardening bags set aside. Show preparation and anticipation, with no gardening underway and no other people. Frame the potted sapling and microphone clearly. No planted tree, broken planter, watering can, cord, rope, barriers, signs, name tags, visible tools used by pupils, or calendar.
alt: La Mar presenta una notícia al pati, al costat d’un arbre jove encara dins del test.
notes: Il·lustració contextual pròpia; els models fixen la identitat dels recurrents. Revisió independent abans de publicar. Conversió a WebP, sense retoc del contingut.
